entities.summary: Anthony Paul Taylor is an American former professional basketball player who was selected by the Atlanta Hawks in the second round of the 1988 NBA draft. A 6-foot-4-inch (1.93 m) point guard from the University of Oregon, Taylor played for only one year (1988–89) with the Miami Heat, their inaugural NBA season.
